_comment: Template for MentorEval runs. Copy this file and modify the configuration as needed.

_benchmark_modes.mentoreval: Full benchmark with all training data, rubric, and explanations
_benchmark_modes.mentoreval-test: Test benchmark with limited training data (one example per set), rubric, and explanations

_prompt_types.with_explanation: Forces LLM to provide brief explanations for each grade
_prompt_types.grade_only: Expects only the actual grade without explanations
